```{r}
library(terra)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
dat<-read_csv(here("raw_data/offshore_infrastructure_v20231106.csv"))

wind<-dat %>% 
  filter(label %in% c("possible_wind", "probable_wind", "wind"))
```

```{r}
table(wind$label)
```

```{r}
wind_latlon<-wind %>% 
  select(lat, lon)
```

# Turn CSV into raster

```{r}
wind_ras<-rasterize(x = wind_latlon, y = )
```
